articles.title: Stray Cattle Disrupt Traffic On Busy Roads, Raise Accident Risk In MP's Susner
articles.description: Stray cattle on busy roads in Madhya Pradesh’s Susner are disrupting traffic and raising accident concerns, especially during evening hours. Residents said cattle returned after roads were cleared for a minister’s visit. Citizens have demanded regular monitoring and removal drives, while the municipal council promised to examine the issue.

articles.title: Bhopal Rehan Murder Case: Evidence Seized As Accused Move To Judicial Custody
articles.description: Accused in the murder of 16-year-old Rehan have been sent to judicial custody after their police remand ended. Police recovered clothes, a cap and other items allegedly linked to the crime, while verifying the knife purchase and car trail. Four CCTV recordings have also emerged as investigators continue probing the case.

articles.title: Bhavnagar Hooch toll rises to 9; 17 hospitalised, 3 in ICU
articles.description: Nine people died from spurious liquor in Bhavnagar by Saturday evening. Seventeen individuals remained hospitalized, with three in critical condition after consuming the toxic brew. Police arrested thirteen people and named twenty-one in the FIR, identifying Raees as the mastermind. Forensic reports confirmed high methanol content, which made the liquor fatally toxic. Raw materials were sourced from Madhya Pradesh and Ahmedabad for final production in Bhavnagar.

articles.title: Gang Duping Women With Fake Currency Bundles Active In Bhopal
articles.description: A gang allegedly targeting women with fake currency bundles has been active across the city, with nearly a dozen incidents reported in recent months. articles.title: Fire Safety Lapses Put Thousands At Risk In Major Hospitals In Bhopal
articles.description: A fire at Deepshikha Hospital has exposed gaps in mandatory fire safety audits, raising concerns over patient safety. Though the hospital had a Fire NOC, its audit was not renewed. JP Hospital and two Gandhi Medical College buildings also reportedly lack Fire NOCs, putting emergency preparedness under scrutiny.
